verdict.rationale: Fastmail is a proprietary hosted webmail service; the pack shows JMAP is an open *standard* (docs-21) and links a page titled 'Open source and standards' (docs-23), but there is no evidence describing which parts of Fastmail's actual product source are published or under what license — no repository, license file, or code excerpt is cited. Protocol openness is not the same as source-code openness, so the story's claim is unevidenced.
